text:
Jules (Partnerships): Quick sync — QBR is 2 weeks out. We need: updated partner scorecards, tier change recs, and an MDF runoff plan. Can we lock owners by tomorrow?
Raj (Finance): I can own the MDF runoff. Will need the list of active requests + committed runway. sending template in a sec.
Maya (GTM): I’ll own the QBR narrative + slides. Need the top 6 partners we want to highlight and any joint announcement asks.
Liam (SI Partnerships): I’ll take SI integrations + enablement updates. Quick ask — any partners on the cusp of tier promotion?
Ana (Marketplace): Two partners (CloudRange & OrbitSys) requested increased listing credits and co-marketing. Both tied to upcoming marketplace launch.
Jules (Partnerships): Good — please confirm promotion candidates: OrbitSys (meets ARR & integrations), AeroSys (still missing 2 case studies).
Raj (Finance): Uploading MDF runoff template here: https://redwood.company/sheets/mdf-runoff-template
Raj (Finance): Quick budget snapshot: current MDF pool is $420k. Planned carryover to next quarter if not used = $60k. We need to reconcile ~7 outstanding requests totaling ~$210k.
Maya (GTM): Flags: CloudRange wants co-announcement in same week as marketplace GA — will need PR coordination and legal signoff.
Liam (SI Partnerships): OrbitSys meets promotion gating on integration QA and customer reference. I can fast-track integration QA if dev resources are available.
Jules (Partnerships): Proposal: prioritize 3 quick wins for QBR highlights (OrbitSys, CloudRange, SynapticAI). Lower-priority requests we defer to next MDF batch. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Ana (Marketplace): Agree. SynapticAI has strong story and demo-ready. CloudRange is high visibility for marketplace.
Raj (Finance): Works for budget. If we fund OrbitSys + CloudRange + SynapticAI, projected spend = $138k. Leaves ~$72k cushion.
Maya (GTM): Action items: I’ll draft the QBR slide for highlights. @Liam please share an integration status blurb (1-2 lines) per partner. @Raj confirm PO process timeline.
Liam (SI Partnerships): Will drop blurb by EOD.
Raj (Finance): PO timeline: once MDF decision is approved (by Friday) we can issue POs within 3 business days. Need invoices + SOWs for OrbitSys (co-marketing) and CloudRange (listing credits).
Jules (Partnerships): Cool. Quick MDF triage rubric I'm using (for record):
```
Priority score = (Strategic visibility * 0.4) + (Revenue uplift * 0.3) + (Readiness / time-to-market * 0.2) + (Partner enablement level * 0.1)
>= 75 -> approve this cycle
50-74 -> conditional approve (partial funds / milestone-based)
<50 -> defer
```
Maya (GTM): Love the rubric. Can we map existing requests quickly? I can run the first pass.
Ana (Marketplace): One more: OrbitSys requested a co-funded booth at APAC summit. That would be an extra $25k ask — not in current requests. Should we consider as separate contingency?
Raj (Finance): Mark it as contingency. We can only approve if someone reallocates or if we use carryover.
Jules (Partnerships): Decision timeline: Friday EOD final MDF list + owners assigned. Next QBR dry-run Wed next week.
DeployBot: Reminder: QBR deck template updated — new slide order enforced. See /qbr/deck/template-v3
Maya (GTM): OK locking owners: Raj (MDF), Maya (QBR narrative + slides), Liam (SI updates), Ana (marketplace asks), Jules (overall partner ops).
Jules (Partnerships): Perfect. Final asks before I close this thread? :eyes:
Liam (SI Partnerships): Please add a quick checklist for integration references (customer, success metric, demo link). I’ll attach examples.
Jules (Partnerships): Noted. Closing loop: will post consolidated spreadsheet by 11am tomorrow with recommended approvals and PO amounts. Thanks team :rocket:
